proof_steps: lem:pg-det-gradient-coprime: Smooth total f implies gcd(f_x,f_y,f_z)=1. If common homogeneous factor h existed, h=f_{u1}=...=f_{um}=0 would have a nonzero projective solution by Krull height, giving gradient zero.

lem:pg-det-classical-kernel: For cubic p with d_x p wedge d_x f=0, fraction field factor a is in S by gcd1, and homogeneous degrees force a constant. Thus classical cubic Casimirs C f + C[u]_3 and classical D matrix rank r=binom(m+5,3)-binom(m+2,3)-1 for all smooth total f.

lem:pg-det-universal-rank: Smooth total cubic coefficient space T is reduced irreducible. A dense open has smooth g, for which exact Hesse central cubic is known. Universal degree3/4 Weyl commutator matrix D(f,h) is algebraic near T x {0} by PBW. All (r+1)-minors vanish on the dense generic-g open and hence identically on T near h=0. Thus rank D(f,h)<=r for every smooth total f, even with singular/zero g.

thm:pg-universal-determinant: A nonzero r x r classical minor at each f remains invertible around h=0. Cramer column replacement gives Omega_h=f_cent+a(sym(w0)-sum(det M_j/det M) sym(w_j)), an EXACT algebraic central cubic with Omega_0=f. Reversal + h->-h forces coefficients rational in h^2 and the denominator is nonzero at h=0.

lem:pg-central-splitting-smooth: For a smooth X with normal form F=sum f_s(x_s,u), redistribute the pure-central cubic c(u)=sum c_s(u). Each block is already smooth at u=0 by smoothness of X, and is generically smooth off u=0 by Bertini applied to the base-point-free system of pure-center cubics. All blocks can simultaneously be made smooth on an irreducible affine distribution space, without changing active partials or Poisson structure.

thm:pg-quantization: Apply exact algebraic centre to each smooth block after pure-center splitting; sum them. Existing PBW, tensor Koszul, central regularity via active-degree leading symbols, change of rings and finite-rank flatness complete the AS-regular ambient and AS-Gorenstein central quotient.

thm:pg-ad-all-poisson: Independent block parameters give a simultaneous k-variable algebraic quantum pencil for ALL ternary restrictions; centres are rational in each eta_s^2 and have no cross-block eta products.
